title: Tlatelolco, twin island city and commercial capital of the Mexica
note: Founded on the adjacent northern islet c. 1337; famous for its enormous central marketplace described by Cortés and Bernal Díaz; conquered and absorbed by Tenochtitlan in 1473 under Axayácatl; last stand of Cuauhtémoc on 13 August 1521.

title: Formation of the Aztec Triple Alliance (Tenochtitlan, Texcoco, Tlacopan)
note: Defeat of the Tepanec empire of Azcapotzalco led by Itzcóatl of Tenochtitlan and Nezahualcóyotl of Texcoco, establishing the Triple Alliance that came to dominate central Mesoamerica and fund Tenochtitlan's growth.

title: Toxcatl massacre of Mexica nobility in the Templo Mayor
note: Massacre of unarmed Mexica nobles and celebrants gathered for the feast of Tóxcatl in the sacred precinct by Pedro de Alvarado in May 1520, triggering open war and the expulsion of Spanish forces during La Noche Triste.

title: Smallpox epidemic in central Mexico (Hueyzahuatl)
note: Devastating Virgin Soil epidemic that swept central Mexico between September and November 1520, killing the tlatoani Cuitláhuac, paralyzing Mexica defence, and claiming an estimated 5–8 million lives across Mexico.
